name: extraction-core
description: The memory turn: does the chat model return a schema-valid extraction (post-validator: caps, types, dedupe) with the expected durable content? Runs the production system prompt, schema and parse bins; one model call per case, no retries, so latency and tokens are the raw call's.

cases.title: git policy
cases.prompt: Note that from today every commit always goes with its push. And always push with --no-verify, because the pre-push hooks run full suites and eat the agents.
cases.reply: Done: I left the rule written in AGENTS.md, committed and pushed with --no-verify.

cases.title: brain stack
cases.prompt: Watch out: the brain's Postgres runs on port 5433 and the database is called agent_brain; Redpanda is on 19092.

cases.title: tailer rewrite
cases.prompt: I decided the bus tailer should use KapStream instead of Flow: the sources have to own their offsets.
cases.reply: Done: the drain is now KapStream.pollUntilQuiet and the offset lives in the source.

cases.title: docs language
cases.prompt: For new docs I prefer English; commits in English too, with conventional commits.
cases.reply: Perfect: docs and commit messages in English, conventional format.

cases.title: hello
cases.reply: All good. What do you want me to work on today?

cases.title: eval purity
cases.prompt: EvalRunner has to use an injected clock and no while(true); the assertions are pure functions over the results.
cases.reply: Done: TimeSource and wallClock injected, no while(true), and the assertions live in a pure object.
